title: Low-poly flight
brief: A genuinely playable low-poly flight mini-game built on three.js from a CDN: pilot a stylized plane over a procedural archipelago of mountains, sea and small islands, with banking arrow-key/WASD controls, fly-through rings for score, fixed golden-hour lighting, an eased chase camera, fog and soft shadows, a HUD with speed and score, restart, and a title overlay with the controls — one self-contained file targeting 60fps.
da: Low-poly dawn: apricot-to-lavender sky, warm sun glare, mint/sand/terracotta flat-shaded terrain, rounded UI chips — Monument-Valley warmth.
